text:
Situation: Azacitidine has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2020-12-18 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General and Corvale East both stock NDC 16729030610 labeled by Accord Healthcare Inc. That NDC's SPL set ID 70140e11 identifies Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473) ending 2022-12-02 and classified it OAI with 11 observations on the Form 483. The OAI classification letter is dated 2023-04-05, which is 714 days after the shortage posting on 2020-12-18. An import alert 66-40 for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited was published on 2023-06-01 and a warning letter issued on 2023-07-28.

Our position: The rule-based best option is to transfer 15 units of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 15 units of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories (Sindan-Pharma Srl plant, NAI 2024-08-02) — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories (alternate label) — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or alternative regimens; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
